pace: Airport pickup; activities from 1 pm, mostly by metro

items.title: Land at the airport, collect luggage
items.tip: After landing, check that mobile data works and open Amap (高德地图) plus WeChat Pay or Alipay. Save the pickup driver's number beforehand.

items.title: Pickup car to Atour Hotel (亚朵)
Leave luggage at the hotel
items.note: Ask whether early check-in is possible, for a shower and change of clothes.

items.title: Lunch
items.note: Near the hotel; keep it quick.

food.name: Baohua Noodle Shop (宝华面店)
food.desc: Long-running shop on Baohua Road. Bamboo-pole wonton noodles (竹升云吞面); served fast.

food.name: Ng Choi Kee Noodles (吴财记面家)
food.desc: Datong Road. Fresh shrimp wonton noodles, fried wontons.

food.name: Ng Zham Kee (伍湛记)
food.desc: Longjin East Road. Jidi congee (及第粥), salty fried dough cakes (咸煎饼).

items.title: Hotel → Animation City (动漫星城)
items.note: Walk to Changshou Lu Station; take Metro Line 1 (towards Guangzhou East Railway Station) to Gongyuanqian Station, 3 stops, ~10 min. Or taxi, ~15 min.
items.tip: Mobile signal may be weak in the underground mall. A meeting point and time should be agreed first.

items.title: Animation City (动漫星城)
items.note: Under Gongyuanqian metro station; Guangzhou's densest anime and manga mall.

items.title: Animation City → Shangxiajiu
items.note: The metro is the easiest option; no transfer needed.

route.title: Gongyuanqian Station (公园前站)
route.desc: Animation City is inside the station. Follow the signs in and take Line 1 (towards Xilang).

route.title: Changshou Lu Station (长寿路站)
route.desc: Before exiting, look for the exit signed “上下九步行街”.

route.title: Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street (上下九步行街)
route.desc: Enter “上下九步行街” in Amap and start walking navigation. Arrival is obvious from the long row of arcade buildings.

items.title: Shangxiajiu: shopping, dinner, dessert
items.note: One straight street, walked there and back; no turns, no getting lost.

route.title: Heritage shops on Dishifu Road (第十甫路老字号)
route.desc: Photos at the old signboards of Tao Tao Ju (陶陶居) and Lin Heung Lau (莲香楼). Gifts can be bought at Lin Heung Lau.

route.title: Xiajiu Road and Shangjiu Road arcades (下九路、上九路骑楼)
route.walk: Keep walking along the pedestrian street
route.desc: Guangzhou's most complete arcade-building (qilou) street, lined with budget clothing, shoe and small shops. Walk to the end of Shangjiu Road, then turn back.
route.tip: The street is crowded in the evening; backpacks should be worn on the front.

route.title: Hualin Jade Street (华林玉器街)
route.walk: On the way back, turn off Xiajiu Road, ~3 min
route.desc: A cluster of jade and jewellery shops; for browsing only. If the entrance is unclear, ask a shopkeeper or skip it.

route.title: Dinner
route.walk: Back to the west end of Dishifu Road. Chen Tim Kee is in Lane 3, Shiwufu, Baohua Road; Yinji is on Wenchang North Road. Both ~5 min on foot.

food.name: Chen Tim Kee (陈添记)
food.desc: Lane 3, Shiwufu, Baohua Road; a Xiguan snack shop tucked in an alley

food.name: Yinji Rice Rolls (银记肠粉)
food.desc: Original shop on Wenchang North Road

food.name: Crunchy fish skin, sampan congee (爽鱼皮、艇仔粥)
Shrimp rice rolls, beef rice rolls (鲜虾肠粉、牛肉肠粉)
food.desc: Yinji signatures; add a bowl of congee

food.name: Nanxin Desserts (南信甜品)
food.desc: Dishifu Road. Double-skin milk (双皮奶), ginger milk curd (姜撞奶).

food.name: Shun Kee Ice Bar (顺记冰室)
food.desc: Baohua Road. For ice cream, go here instead; signature coconut ice cream.

route.title: Leave Shangxiajiu
route.desc: Taxi from the roadside on Wenchang South Road back to the hotel, ~10 min.
